function.arguments: {"index": 4, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The raw comparison of conversion rates between email and paid_search is confounded by customer_segment because the email campaign was deliberately targeted at loyal customers, who have higher baseline conversion rates. To estimate the true campaign effect, I computed the difference in conversion rates within each customer_segment (email - paid_search), then averaged these differences using the number of email orders in each segment as weights. This gives a weighted average difference that adjusts for the imbalance in segment composition between channels. The result is a more accurate estimate of the causal effect of the email campaign relative to paid_search."}
function.name: resolve_finding
